items.headline: Mark our own test visits so traffic numbers mean something
items.detail: Our browser suites write page views into the same table as real visitors, so a run inflates the count and 'did a real person visit' cannot be answered.

items.headline: aichieve.net has no robots.txt and no sitemap.xml
items.detail: Done 2026-10-19, verified live: https://aichieve.net/robots.txt answers 200 (66 B — `User-agent: *`, `Allow: /`, `Sitemap: https://aichieve.net/sitemap.xml`) and https://aichieve.net/sitemap.xml answers 200 as a sitemap index pointing at sitemap-0.xml, which lists 110 URLs (home, article paths, hubs, /about/) — three listed paths re-probed 200. Closed on the owner's instruction `@Simon aichieve robots and sitemap`; no code change was needed from the factory because the front already serves both.
items.impact: Closed — crawlers and AI agents get a rule set and a sitemap to follow on aichieve.net.

items.headline: Delete the last QuarterLine references
items.detail: Done 2026-10-19: the legacy plugin descriptor was DELETED (it advertised the killed product and an /openapi.json URL that answered 404). /.well-known/mcp.json, generated from the live inventory, is the one agent descriptor; a guard test now fails the build when any /.well-known file names a retired product, slug or tool, and the receipt sender no longer names it either.
items.impact: Closed — no published descriptor or customer email names a product we no longer sell.

items.headline: Four superseded launch-video copies deleted from the channel
items.detail: Done 2026-10-19 on the owner's instruction: the four superseded uploads the pages no longer embed (LdSoKLTfYjs, V-eli97M0q0, 4cNR2bt3mMg, uodX_D-Gqsw) were deleted via the YouTube API (HTTP 204 each, 0 resolve on re-read). The five embedded ids read public and untouched; all five product pages 200 with their own id; the launch_videos ledger repointed to the survivors (5/5 live, 0 mismatches).
items.impact: Closed — one film per product online and no dead pointers.

items.headline: One copy of the W-2 vs 1099 and RSU hold-vs-sell engines — giniloh.com
items.detail: The factory-repo duplicate (src/lib/calc/*.ts + 11 vitest) and the two scripts that copied code into /root/giniloh are deleted. The live giniloh.com copy is the single home, and scripts/check-calculators.mjs now pins ~50 known answers from the 2026 spec vector, so a changed constant fails instead of quietly changing someone's pay numbers.
items.impact: Closed 2026-10-19: one engine per calculator, drift impossible, regressions caught locally.

items.headline: One-line fix for the IDE header gap and gutter alignment
items.detail: Done 2026-10-19 (owner: `@Simon fix the header gap`): both IDE chrome bars carry `gap-x-3` + `flex-wrap`, `min-w-0`/`truncate` on the title and `shrink-0` on the badge group, and below `sm` the badge prints the claim alone ("ZERO EGRESS"). Measured before the fix: the editable bar's badge overran the bar and painted over the file title at 375 px (−34.0 px on all four products). /parcelproof's Recovery-summary badge no longer squeezes to a two-line pill. A new build-time guard in tests/e2e/text-geometry.spec.ts measures the chrome boxes at 1280 px and 375 px and was proven to bite by reverting the components. Gate green end to end (96/96 Playwright, visual-QA 24/24).
items.impact: Closed — the badge never touches the file title at 1280 px or 375 px, and the build fails if it does.

items.headline: Supplier geolocation pre-flight audit for the EU deforestation rules (EUDR)
items.detail: A model reads the declared fields out of supplier packs; overlap, declared-vs-computed area and scope are checked by our own geometry. Plan in five slices, S1 engine through S5 gate + deploy.
items.impact: Build in progress since 2026-10-18. EUDR application date is 30 December 2026.
